rows.name: WBTC
farm_steps: Start from a fresh wallet funded only with what you plan to farm, and write the seed phrase down offline. Cost: $2-$8 of network fees per transaction on Bitcoin for the first transaction. Time: 5 minutes.

Bridge $400 of USDC through WBTC to Bitcoin and back once, then leave a small balance on the far side so the wallet shows real bridge use. Cost: $400 of working capital plus $2-$8 of network fees per transaction on Bitcoin to set up. Time: 15 minutes.
Touch the protocol once a week with a real action, so no weekly snapshot finds the wallet idle. Plan on 6 weekly touches. Cost: roughly $30 of gas over the window. Time: 10 minutes a week.

Hold the position for at least 45 days; launch snapshots usually reward wallets that stayed, not wallets that visited once. Cost: the $400 stays in the position; nothing more out of pocket. Time: 45 days.

Log the wallet, the dates, the capital and every transaction. Total expected spend for this plan: $400 of capital (recoverable on exit) plus about $45 of gas over 45 days. Cost: nothing but the log. Time: 5 minutes.
